# Support

Use [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/kylbutlr/app-stylr/issues) for reproducible bugs, documentation gaps, and focused feature requests.

Include the App Stylr version, installation channel, platform, Node or Swift version, a minimal reproduction, and the complete error output. For visual questions, include the affected semantic token, theme, viewport, and a screenshot when possible.

Use [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/kylbutlr/app-stylr/security/advisories/new) for security-sensitive reports.

App Stylr does not provide application-specific implementation support, automatic consumer upgrades, or guarantees for unlisted frameworks and platforms.
